title: Audit telemetry mapping and differential payload pattern for hierarchical RBAC operations
creator: Anika Patel
description: Goal: Define a pragmatic, queryable audit telemetry mapping and a compact differential payload pattern tailored for hierarchical RBAC operations (role grants/revokes, inheritance changes, permission deltas) that integrates SSO/SAML context and admin controls. The output will be a developer-friendly event shape, a compact delta encoding format for changes, enrichment rules for SSO/session attribution, and migration guidelines for existing audit events. This ticket focuses on the schema and taxonomy (what to log), event linking and lookup keys, and the delta encoding choice (sparse field diffs vs compact change-sets). We will prioritize: (1) retaining investigatory signal for security/forensics and compliance, (2) keeping per-event size small for high-volume admin churn, (3) making it possible to reconstruct state at any point for audits, and (4) protecting PII by redaction and sampling rules.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver a canonical event envelope and a human-readable field list for actor/target/context that stakeholders (secops, compliance, infra) sign off on
Define a delta encoding that reduces average admin-change payload size by >= 60% compared to verbatim full-resource snapshots while enabling full state reconstruction via event replay
Enrichment rules map SSO/SAML assertions to stable actor identifiers and preserve external identity provider references for at least 90 days
Provide migration plan and a compatibility shim so older events remain queryable; include sample queries for common forensic workflows
Document retention and sampling strategy with explicit PII redaction and a cold-storage export plan for long-tail compliance (e.g., 7 years)
proposed_event_shape: operation: <action-string e.g. role.grant, role.revoke, permission.add, role.inherit.change>
actor: { canonical_id, display_name, identity_provider, session_id, session_start }
diff_encoding_spec: Primary format: sparse op-list encoding (ops: add, remove, replace, move) inspired by JSON Patch but restricted to RBAC primitives to keep semantics explicit
Fields in ops must reference canonical field paths (e.g., /roles/role_id/permissions) and include metadata for previous_value_checksum to aid integrity checks
Fallback: zstd compressed canonicalized JSON snapshot for clients that cannot produce op-lists (storage flagged as full-snapshot)
Delta envelopes must be idempotent and include a sequence number for the target resource so reordering can be detected during replay
Small binary deltas allowed for large policy blobs using binary diff (bsdiff) wrapped in the delta_payload with explicit encoding tag
All delta payloads must include a human-readable summary string for quick search and triage in dashboards
sampling_and_retention: High-frequency admin loops (scripted role syncs) are sampled at 1% by default with 100% sampling for events that change inheritance edges or affect owner bindings
PII redaction rules: remove raw SAML assertion content, truncate email local-parts, and strip OAuth tokens before storage; keep identity_provider and external_id references
Hot retention (searchable): 90 days; Warm (cost-optimized): 2 years; Cold (compliance export): 7 years compressed to cold bucket
Special retention exemptions for compliance cases flagged by 'legal_hold' attribute which pins events to hot tier until lift
Sampling metadata must be stored with event headers so downstream analysis can correct for sample bias
migration_plan: Backfill strategy: convert existing v1 audit snapshots into v2 envelope with delta_payload as compressed snapshot and pre_image_ref set to null; annotate with migration_marker
Compatibility shim: query layer will accept both v1 and v2 shapes and expose virtual fields computed on-the-fly (e.g., computed_effective_permissions) for legacy tooling
Phased rollout: instrumentation rollout to control plane (stage -> canary -> global) with feature flag that toggles delta encoding generation
Instrumentation tests: replay test harness that replays a week of admin events and validates that replayed state matches canonical store within tolerances
Developer docs: Confluence doc with example patches, sample queries, and python/ts helper libs for encode/decode
open_risks: Operator errors in delta generation could leave gaps if sequence numbers are missed; mitigation: strict ACKing and backfill job
Over-redaction may remove investigatory detail needed by secops; mitigation: redaction whitelist per policy and shorter hot retention for raw fields locked behind legal_hold
Sampling could hide automated attack patterns; mitigation: anomaly detector that forces full capture when suspicious rate thresholds hit
Large-scale role-syncs may still produce many full-snapshot fallbacks increasing storage costs; mitigation: recommend use of op-list producers for sync tooling and provide SDK helpers
